SELECT p."body"
FROM "tags" t
JOIN "posts" p ON p."id" = t."excerptpostid"
WHERE t."tagname" = 'bayesian';

SELECT "u"."age"
FROM "users" AS "u"
WHERE "u"."reputation" = (SELECT MAX("reputation") FROM "users")
ORDER BY "u"."age" DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS vote_count
FROM votes v
WHERE v."userid" = 58
  AND v."creationdate"::date = TO_DATE('2010-07-19', 'YYYY-MM-DD');

SELECT u."reputation"
FROM "badges" b
JOIN "users" u ON u."id" = b."userid"
WHERE b."date" = '2010-07-19 19:39:08.0';

SELECT DISTINCT b."name"
FROM "badges" b
JOIN "users" u ON b."userid" = u."id"
WHERE u."reputation" = (SELECT MIN("reputation") FROM "users");
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "userid") FROM "badges" GROUP BY "userid" HAVING COUNT("name") > 5;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS post_count
FROM "posts" p
JOIN "users" u ON p."owneruserid" = u."id"
WHERE u."displayname" = 'Daniel Vassallo';

SELECT "u"."id"
FROM "users" AS "u"
ORDER BY "u"."reputation" DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;

SELECT p."viewcount", p."lasteditordisplayname"
FROM "posts" p
WHERE p."body" = 'Computer Game Datasets'
ORDER BY p."lasactivitydate" DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "posts" p WHERE p."owneruserid" = 24)::NUMERIC
  /
  NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "votes" v WHERE v."userid" = 24), 0)::NUMERIC
  AS posts_to_votes_ratio;

SELECT u."creationdate", u."age"
FROM comments c
JOIN users u ON u."id" = c."userid"
WHERE c."text" LIKE '%http://%';

SELECT p."id"
FROM "posts" p
JOIN "users" u ON p."owneruserid" = u."id"
WHERE u."displayname" = 'slashnick'
ORDER BY p."answercount" DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;

SELECT c."text", c."userdisplayname"
FROM "comments" c
JOIN "posts" p ON c."postid" = p."id"
WHERE p."title" = 'Analysing wind data with R'
ORDER BY c."creationdate" DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

SELECT p."id", b."name"
FROM posts p
JOIN comments c ON c."postid" = p."id"
JOIN badges b ON b."userid" = c."userid"
WHERE c."userdisplayname" LIKE '%Samuel%'
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c."creationdate"::TIMESTAMP) = 2013
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM b."date"::TIMESTAMP) = 2013
GROUP BY p."id", b."name"
ORDER BY p."id" ASC NULLS FIRST, b."name" ASC NULLS FIRST;

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN u."upvotes" = 0 THEN c."userid" END) * 100.0
  / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT c."userid"), 0) AS percentage
FROM "comments" c
JOIN "users" u ON u."id" = c."userid"
WHERE c."score" BETWEEN 5 AND 10;

SELECT p."favoritecount"
FROM comments c
JOIN posts p ON p."id" = c."postid"
WHERE c."userid" = 3025
  AND c."creationdate" = '2014-04-23 20:29:39'::timestamp;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS post_count
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.owneruserid = u.id
WHERE u.displayname = 'Matt Parker'
  AND p.score > 4;
SELECT p."viewcount" FROM "posts" p WHERE p."title" = 'Integration of Weka and/or RapidMiner into Informatica PowerCenter/Developer';

SELECT DISTINCT p."tags"
FROM "posts" p
JOIN "users" u ON p."owneruserid" = u."id"
WHERE u."displayname" = 'Mark Meckes'
  AND p."commentcount" = 0;

SELECT u."displayname"
FROM votes v
JOIN posts p ON v."postid" = p."id"
JOIN users u ON v."userid" = u."id"
WHERE v."bountyamount" = 50
  AND p."title" ILIKE '%variance%';

SELECT
  (COUNT(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "date"::timestamp) = 2010 THEN 1 END)::numeric
   / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) * 100)
  -
  (COUNT(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "date"::timestamp) = 2011 THEN 1 END)::numeric
   / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) * 100) AS percentage_difference
FROM "badges"
WHERE "name" = 'Student';

SELECT p."title", p."viewcount"
FROM "posts" p
JOIN "users" u ON p."owneruserid" = u."id"
WHERE u."displayname" LIKE '%Harvey Motulsky%' OR u."displayname" LIKE '%Noah Snyder%'
ORDER BY p."viewcount" DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p."tags" LIKE '%<r>%' THEN p."id" END)::NUMERIC
  / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT p."id"), 0) * 100 AS percentage
FROM "posts" p
JOIN "users" u ON p."owneruserid" = u."id"
WHERE u."displayname" = 'Community';

SELECT
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p."score" > 50)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) * 100 AS percentage
FROM "posts" p
WHERE p."owneruserid" = (
  SELECT u."id"
  FROM "users" u
  ORDER BY u."reputation" DESC NULLS LAST
  LIMIT 1
);

SELECT DISTINCT s."superhero_name"
FROM "superhero" s
JOIN "hero_attribute" ha ON ha."hero_id" = s."id"
WHERE ha."attribute_value" BETWEEN 75 AND 80;
SELECT p."id" FROM "publisher" p WHERE p."publisher_name" = 'Star Trek';

SELECT s."full_name"
FROM "superhero" s
JOIN "hero_power" hp ON hp."hero_id" = s."id"
GROUP BY s."id", s."full_name"
HAVING COUNT(hp."power_id") > 15;

SELECT s."superhero_name"
FROM "superhero" s
JOIN "alignment" a ON s."alignment_id" = a."id"
WHERE a."alignment" = 'Neutral';
SELECT sp."id" FROM "superpower" sp WHERE sp."power_name" = 'cryokinesis';

SELECT c."colour"
FROM "superhero" s
JOIN "colour" c ON s."skin_colour_id" = c."id"
WHERE s."superhero_name" = 'Apocalypse';

SELECT sp."power_name"
FROM "superhero" s
JOIN "hero_power" hp ON hp."hero_id" = s."id"
JOIN "superpower" sp ON sp."id" = hp."power_id"
WHERE s."full_name" ILIKE '%Hunter%Zolomon%';

SELECT sp."power_name"
FROM "superhero" s
JOIN "hero_power" hp ON hp."hero_id" = s."id"
JOIN "superpower" sp ON sp."id" = hp."power_id"
WHERE s."superhero_name" = 'Abomination';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s."id") AS fastest_superheroes_count
FROM "superhero" s
JOIN "hero_attribute" ha ON ha."hero_id" = s."id"
JOIN "attribute" a ON a."id" = ha."attribute_id"
WHERE a."attribute_name" = 'Speed'
  AND ha."attribute_value" = 100;

SELECT r."race"
FROM "superhero" s
JOIN "race" r ON s."race_id" = r."id"
WHERE s."superhero_name" ILIKE 'Copycat';

SELECT s."height_cm"
FROM "superhero" s
JOIN "colour" c ON s."eye_colour_id" = c."id"
WHERE c."colour" = 'Amber';

SELECT s."superhero_name"
FROM "superhero" s
JOIN "hero_attribute" ha ON ha."hero_id" = s."id"
JOIN "attribute" a ON a."id" = ha."attribute_id"
WHERE a."attribute_name" = 'Speed'
ORDER BY ha."attribute_value" DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT c."colour"
FROM "superhero" s
JOIN "hero_attribute" ha ON ha."hero_id" = s."id"
JOIN "colour" c ON c."id" = s."skin_colour_id"
WHERE ha."attribute_value" = 100;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s."id") AS count
FROM "superhero" s
JOIN "colour" c ON s."eye_colour_id" = c."id"
JOIN "hero_power" hp ON s."id" = hp."hero_id"
JOIN "superpower" sp ON hp."power_id" = sp."id"
WHERE c."colour" = 'Blue'
  AND sp."power_name" = 'Agility';

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN g."gender" = 'Male' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::NUMERIC
  / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN g."gender" = 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS ratio
FROM "superhero" s
JOIN "gender" g ON g."id" = s."gender_id";

SELECT s."superhero_name"
FROM "superhero" s
JOIN "colour" ec ON ec."id" = s."eye_colour_id"
JOIN "colour" hc ON hc."id" = s."hair_colour_id"
WHERE ec."colour" = 'Blue'
  AND hc."colour" = 'Brown';

SELECT s."superhero_name", s."height_cm"
FROM "superhero" s
JOIN "publisher" p ON s."publisher_id" = p."id"
WHERE p."publisher_name" = 'Marvel Comics'
ORDER BY s."height_cm" DESC NULLS LAST;

SELECT s."superhero_name"
FROM "superhero" s
JOIN "hero_attribute" ha ON ha."hero_id" = s."id"
JOIN "attribute" a ON a."id" = ha."attribute_id"
WHERE a."attribute_name" = 'Intelligence'
ORDER BY ha."attribute_value" ASC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;

SELECT g."gender"
FROM "superhero" s
JOIN "hero_power" hp ON hp."hero_id" = s."id"
JOIN "superpower" sp ON sp."id" = hp."power_id"
JOIN "gender" g ON g."id" = s."gender_id"
WHERE sp."power_name" = 'Phoenix Force';

SELECT sp."power_name"
FROM "superhero" sh
JOIN "hero_power" hp ON hp."hero_id" = sh."id"
JOIN "superpower" sp ON sp."id" = hp."power_id"
WHERE sh."height_cm" > (SELECT AVG("height_cm") * 0.8 FROM "superhero")
GROUP BY sp."power_name"
ORDER BY sp."power_name" ASC NULLS FIRST;

SELECT p."publisher_name"
FROM "superhero" s
JOIN "publisher" p ON s."publisher_id" = p."id"
WHERE s."superhero_name" IN ('Hawkman', 'Karate Kid', 'Speedy');

SELECT AVG(s."height_cm") AS average_height
FROM "superhero" s
JOIN "race" r ON s."race_id" = r."id"
JOIN "publisher" p ON s."publisher_id" = p."id"
WHERE r."race" <> 'Human'
  AND p."publisher_name" = 'Dark Horse Comics';

SELECT
  (SUM(CASE WHEN g."id" = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::NUMERIC / COUNT(a."id")) * 100.0 AS female_percentage
FROM "superhero" s
JOIN "alignment" a ON s."alignment_id" = a."id"
JOIN "gender" g ON s."gender_id" = g."id"
WHERE a."id" = 2;

SELECT
  (SUM(CASE WHEN a."alignment" = 'Good' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::NUMERIC
   / COUNT(*)::NUMERIC) * 100.0 AS good_percentage
FROM "superhero" s
JOIN "publisher" p ON s."publisher_id" = p."id"
JOIN "alignment" a ON s."alignment_id" = a."id"
WHERE p."publisher_name" = 'Marvel Comics';

SELECT
  (SUM(CASE WHEN p."publisher_name" = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::NUMERIC
   / COUNT(p."id")::NUMERIC) * 100 AS marvel_percentage
FROM "superhero" s
JOIN "publisher" p ON s."publisher_id" = p."id"
WHERE s."height_cm" BETWEEN 150 AND 180;

SELECT
  (SUM(CASE WHEN c."colour" = 'Blue' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::NUMERIC
   / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)) * 100 AS percentage
FROM "superhero" s
JOIN "gender" g ON s."gender_id" = g."id"
JOIN "colour" c ON s."skin_colour_id" = c."id"
WHERE g."gender" = 'Female';

SELECT
  (SUM(CASE WHEN a."alignment" = 'Bad' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::NUMERIC / COUNT(s."id")) * 100 AS bad_percentage,
  SUM(CASE WHEN a."alignment" = 'Bad' AND p."publisher_name" = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS marvel_bad_count
FROM "superhero" s
JOIN "alignment" a ON s."alignment_id" = a."id"
JOIN "publisher" p ON s."publisher_id" = p."id";

SELECT s."superhero_name"
FROM "superhero" s
JOIN "colour" ec ON s."eye_colour_id" = ec."id"
JOIN "colour" hc ON s."hair_colour_id" = hc."id"
WHERE ec."colour" = 'Blue'
  AND hc."colour" = 'Blond';

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN p."publisher_name" = 'DC Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dc_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN p."publisher_name" = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS marvel_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN p."publisher_name" = 'DC Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    - SUM(CASE WHEN p."publisher_name" = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM "superhero" s
JOIN "publisher" p ON s."publisher_id" = p."id"
WHERE p."publisher_name" IN ('DC Comics', 'Marvel Comics');

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN p."publisher_name" = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
  - SUM(CASE WHEN p."publisher_name" = 'DC Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM "superhero" s
JOIN "publisher" p ON s."publisher_id" = p."id"
WHERE p."publisher_name" IN ('DC Comics', 'Marvel Comics');

SELECT ec."colour" AS eye_colour, hc."colour" AS hair_colour, sc."colour" AS skin_colour
FROM "superhero" s
JOIN "gender" g ON s."gender_id" = g."id"
JOIN "publisher" p ON s."publisher_id" = p."id"
JOIN "colour" ec ON s."eye_colour_id" = ec."id"
JOIN "colour" hc ON s."hair_colour_id" = hc."id"
JOIN "colour" sc ON s."skin_colour_id" = sc."id"
WHERE g."gender" = 'Female'
  AND p."publisher_name" = 'Dark Horse Comics';

SELECT
  (SUM(CASE WHEN g."gender" = 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::NUMERIC
   / COUNT(*)::NUMERIC) * 100.0 AS female_percentage
FROM "superhero" s
JOIN "publisher" p ON s."publisher_id" = p."id"
JOIN "gender" g ON s."gender_id" = g."id"
WHERE p."publisher_name" = 'George Lucas';

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN c.id = 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN c.id = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS eye_colour_difference
FROM "superhero" s
JOIN "colour" c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.weight_kg = 0 OR s.weight_kg IS NULL;

SELECT s."superhero_name", p."publisher_name"
FROM "superhero" s
JOIN "publisher" p ON s."publisher_id" = p."id"
WHERE s."hair_colour_id" = s."skin_colour_id"
  AND s."hair_colour_id" = s."eye_colour_id";
